findings.result: Exact 1-based mapping of all 16 flat primitive IDs equals frozen type transport; 0, >16 and malformed decimal IDs refuse. packet_text emits full names.

Counter/lease/command/sequence/id/descriptor extent are checked before capacity; first GROW pins response offset/extent/workspace length and counters. Descriptor cache/phase commit happens only after full copy and required shape/id validation; query is not reissued on a local replay.

Actual metadata IR correlates source-index id/stream/extent/used/root and function request/serial/slots. Private issuer ownership and immutable same-borrow replay remain required; header equality alone does not authenticate externally substituted payload bytes.

Both entry points check H_BROKEN first for complete workspaces. Request accepts only phase 1/2, reply only 9/19/20; DONE reaches 21. Replay after DONE or cross-stage request refuses; refused retains initial reason and poisons both images. Short workspace cannot contain poison; caller must dispose on BAD.

Task and step QUERY resolution precede counter bound refusal; build stages preserve packet ordering and field/variant order without hosted selection. Helper header numeric error/final/name and actual 2MiB workspace correlate before DONE. Error does not fabricate a successful helper value.

128KiB helper packet and 4MiB helper output are existing bounded downstream ABI limits; descriptor arena uses offset-based GROW. A GROW retry requires the same private inputs; no payload digest claim was inferred from unchanged header checks.

scope: Read-only review of six frozen production files and matching primitive definitions; no native execution; not full public integration or qualification
